model: Each system lists the shared number after which every one of its āyāt ends. The count belongs to the edition, not the riwāyah: an edition is listed under the system its own ayah_starts match, with what it does at every point where the system's own authorities disagree. system_associated_with_qari is the other question — the system the qāriʾ is associated with, from qiraat.json — and differs_from_association says when the two do not agree.

association.description: The counting system each qāriʾ is associated with. A fact about the qāriʾ, not about any printing: an edition may measure onto another system, and two of these seven do.
association.source: qiraat-ayah-map data/qiraat.json, vendored at the commit above

source.work: الفرائد الحسان في عدّ آي القرآن
source.author: عبد الفتاح القاضي
source.note: قَرِيبًا الْبَصْرِى وَخُلْفٌ مَكِّهِمْ — «عده البصري والمكي يخلف عنه وتركه الباقون»
source.why: al-Dānī's al-Bayān gives the point to Baṣrī alone («عدها البصري ولم يعدها الباقون», sūrah 78, 41 āyahs in Baṣrī and 40 in the rest). al-Farāʾid al-Ḥisān records khilāf within Makkī at the same word, which is what the KFGQPC Bazzī edition follows. The source does not name the authorities on either side.
